title: UNGA 81 — AI governance at the General Debate

nodes.label: Global Digital Compact
nodes.act: Adopted at the Summit of the Future; commits to creating a Global Dialogue on AI Governance
nodes.evidence: The Global Digital Compact, adopted at the Summit of the Future, commits to creating a Global Dialogue on AI Governance.

nodes.label: UNGA Resolution A/RES/79/325
nodes.act: Formally establishes the Global Dialogue on AI Governance, naming co-chairs Egriselda López (El Salvador) and Rein Tammsaar (Estonia)
nodes.evidence: UN General Assembly resolution formally establishes the Global Dialogue on AI Governance.

nodes.label: Global Dialogue on AI Governance — inaugural session
nodes.act: Holds its first session, in Geneva
nodes.evidence: The inaugural session of the Global Dialogue on AI Governance is held in Geneva.

nodes.label: UN Secretary-General
nodes.act: Delivers opening remarks at the Dialogue's inaugural session

nodes.label: Khalilur Rahman, President of the 81st UNGA session
nodes.act: Opens the general debate, calling AI a potential accelerator of progress that also risks job losses, a widening digital divide, and — via AGI — human survival, and calls for prudent guardrails, without naming any mechanism, panel or deadline
nodes.evidence: He names no mechanism, panel or deadline.

nodes.label: Donald Trump, US President
nodes.act: Rejects any 'globalist scheme to control artificial intelligence' and proposes renaming the technology 'superintelligence'
nodes.evidence: The United States totally rejects any attempt to construct a globalist scheme to control artificial intelligence.

nodes.label: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, President of Turkey
nodes.act: Calls for a common international legal framework for AI and to accelerate work on a UN international convention on AI, citing disinformation and cybersecurity threats
nodes.evidence: It is long overdue now to establish a common international legal framework for AI

nodes.label: King Abdullah II of Jordan
nodes.act: Addresses the General Debate on technology's effect on attention spans, without addressing AI regulation or superintelligence
nodes.evidence: He does not address AI regulation or superintelligence.

nodes.label: Global Dialogue on AI Governance — second session
nodes.act: Scheduled for New York, back-to-back with the 11th Multi-stakeholder Forum on Science, Technology and Innovation
nodes.evidence: The second session of the Global Dialogue on AI Governance is scheduled for New York
